The verified FY28 consensus adds about +$13 at 60% weight. Blending with the agents' SOTP/EV legs subtracts. Removing the unverified Anthropic uplift subtracts $4. delta_review.anchoring_check: The blind agent_3 (never saw the 10-02 files) independently found the same inputs: CY27 $14.95, CY28 $17.89 (MarketScreener) and a 21.8x multiple. It lands lower ($346) for four reasons. (1) A skeptic -8% cut to CY28 EPS (judgment). (2) It applies a next-FY multiple to an NTM base, which understates by about 4%. (3) An EV/EBITDA leg at 35% weight ($320). (4) No net cash in its P/E leg. Corrected for (2) and (4) only, it is about $352. So the factual inputs are confirmed independently, and the remaining gap is the skeptic's judgment, not a fact the delta agents inherited. The two delta agents ($362, $370) sit within $4-8 of the 10-02 level, so they are partly anchored, but the inputs they changed (FY28 consensus, peer median) were re-fetched and verified this round.

inputs_detail.input: Anthropic stake estimate 2026-10-19: Google fully diluted ownership at the IPO
inputs_detail.derivation: Shares from the S-1 (Note 9 and the preferred stock table, x10 for the split): Series E-3 12.664M (2023 NPA tranches 1-2), E-4 15.343M, E-5 24.244M (2024 NPA note), G-4 3.322M (2023 NPA tranche 3), G-2 38.59M ($10.0B / $259.1364), Series H $10.0B / $589.0095 = 16.978M -> 1,111.4M post-split (filing). Plus the early-2023 ~$300M equity (Fortune: 'an initial $300 million investment'), est. at the Series C price $11.2261 (S-1) = 26.72M -> 267.2M. Total 1,378.6M / 17,783.7M = 7.752% pre-IPO, x 0.95 = 7.365%. S-1 (filed 2026-10-26, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2130357/000162828026067168/anthropicpbc-sx1.htm): 10-for-1 forward split 2026-09-17; Series H price $589.0095 = $58.9010 post-split; Initial Public Benefit Issuance 846,840,960 Class N shares = '5% of our fully diluted shares as of June 30, 2026 (assuming full conversion of the Amazon Notes)' -> fully diluted 16,936.8M (preferred 853.394M x 10 + Class A 2,157.4M + Class N 30.6M + options/RSUs 2,846.7M + Amazon notes 1,840.4M + donation-matching reserve 933.7M + pool 569.1M = 16,911M, within 0.2%), 17,783.7M after the PBF shares; x 0.95 for primary shares (est.: WSJ 2026-10-26 '$100 billion or more' at $1.5T-$2T with selling stockholders in the S-1 table, https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/anthropic-publicly-files-ipo-ant-155552280.html). Cross-checks: (a) NYT/court filings 2025-03 'about 14%': Google's then 790M shares / 5,718M (preferred 2,202M + common 1,779M + options 1,737M at 12/31/24, S-1) = 13.8%, consistent; dilution since by Series E-H ($3.5B, $13B, $30B, $65B) brings it to ~7.75%. (b) Alphabet Q2 10-Q: $87.9B remeasured in Q2 >= 1,379M x $58.90 = $81.2B. The 14.99% figure in the S-1 is a cap on future Google 2026 NPA issuances, not a holding. Google also holds an option to buy up to $10.0B of Class N at the IPO price (value-neutral at that price; it would lift the stake by ~0.67 pts at $1.5T and cut the NPA to $10.0B).

drivers.source: 10-K FY2025 MD&A Monetization Metrics: paid clicks +6% (2025 vs 2024) https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652044/000165204426000018/goog-20251231.htm; Q2-26 10-Q: paid clicks +13% (Q2 and H1 2026 vs 2025) https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652044/000165204426000071/goog-20260630.htm; Q3-26 release (8-K Ex. 99.1, source 62): Search & other $63,350M vs $56,567M (+12.0%); Q2-26 10-Q H1 Search & other $123,670M vs $104,892M; Q3 call (CFO lapping 'a couple of points' in Q4, FX; AI Mode ads scaling) [src 65]; Q4-25 release [src 112]; Tinuiti Q3 2026 via Karooya [src 103]; eMarketer [src 111]
drivers.derivation: REBUILD 2026-11-17 (forecast_lint carry-forward hits; ground-up from usage and monetization evidence). Search & other revenue = 56,133 x paid_clicks x CPC / 1e4 per quarter; clicks = Search & other revenue / 56,133 / CPC x 1e4. Q4 FY2026 Search & other 69,065 = Q4 2025 63,073 (Q4-25 release [src 112]) x 1.095, built from the year-on-year drivers the company named: (a) underlying growth: Q3 FY2026 +12.0% (release [src 62]) with query growth 'the highest it's been in the last 5 years' including commercial queries (Pichai, Q3 call [src 65]); (b) comp: the CFO says Q3 'left about 3 points of growth' to lapping the late-2025 acceleration and Q4 carries 'a couple of points' more (Q3 call [src 65]): -2.0 pt; (c) FX: 'slightly larger FX headwind ... in Q4 relative to the prior quarter', primarily Search and YouTube (Q3 call): -0.5 pt (estimate); (d) monetization: ads in AI Mode go international and multiturn ads launch in the US (Schindler, Q3 call), but AI Mode 'lower monetization' persists: +0.0 net (estimate). 12.0 - 2.0 - 0.5 = +9.5%. Cross-check: Tinuiti's Q3 2026 Google search sample +14% spend, +9% clicks, +4% CPC (relay [src 103]) vs Alphabet's reported +12% / clicks +8% / CPC +4% (Q3 10-Q, p. 51 [src 115]); the agency sample runs ~2 pt above the filed figure, so it does not argue for more. Q4 FY2026 clicks = 69,065 / 56,133 / 1.035 = index 118.88 (+5.8% y/y; CPC +3.5%, see cpc). FY2027-28: OWNER-DECIDED Search & other revenue path (Kilian 2026-10-29: AI keeps cannibalizing Search, no seasonal re-acceleration, smooth deceleration by quarter: +9 / +8.5 / +8 / +7.5% y/y in FY2027 and +7 / +6.75 / +6.5 / +6.25% in FY2028), kept as his decision and applied to the rebuilt Q4 FY2026 base (FY2027 277,147, FY2028 295,476); clicks are that revenue / the evidence-built CPC (not his decision): FY2027 clicks +4.5%, FY2028 +3.4% (index 109.826/114.726/118.635/122.194). FY2029 (not owner-decided): clicks +3.0% y/y each quarter. Case: clicks grow with commercial query volume and ad coverage on AI surfaces less fewer paid clicks per AI Mode query. Up: majority of AI Mode queries are incremental, ads now scaling in AI Overviews/AI Mode to more users and queries and international markets (Schindler, Q3 call [src 65]); 50B+ visual searches a month (Pichai). Down: AI Mode 'lower monetization' (fewer ads per query), Google's US search ad share below half for the first time in more than 20 years (48.5% in 2026, eMarketer [src 111]); Microsoft search clicks -3% in Q3 2026 (Tinuiti relay [src 103]). Net: below the FY2028 click growth the owner's revenue path implies (+3.4%), as AI Mode takes a larger share of queries; with CPC +2.9% Search & other FY2029 = 313,167 (+6.0%). Alternatives sized in judgment_alternatives (paid_clicks). | PREVIOUS: Index only (Alphabet discloses % changes, not levels; the Q3 click/CPC split comes with the 10-Q, not filed yet). Q3 update 2026-10-28: FY2026 Search & other = H1 123,670 (Q2 10-Q) + Q3 63,350 (release) + Q4 69,380 (Q4-25 63,073 = FY25 224,532 - 9M-25 161,459, x 1.10: the CFO says Q4 laps the 2025 acceleration and carries a larger FX headwind) = 256,400 = +14.19% vs FY2025 (was +15.92%, 1.12 x 1.035). CPC is held at 103.5 (H1 +4%, 10-Q; no Q3 figure), so the shortfall goes to paid clicks: 114.19 / 1.035 = 110.33 (was 112.0). Why clicks: queries grew at a five-year high (release) but AI Mode monetizes lower (Schindler, Q3 call), i.e. fewer paid clicks per query, not lower prices. FY2027 +8% (119.16) and FY2028 +7% (127.50): the base round's fade rates kept (ads now scaling in AI Overviews/AI Mode, Q3 call). Kilian 2026-10-29: smooth deceleration by quarter (quarter_derivation): FY2027 +8.2%, FY2028 +6.6% (index 115.93 / 120.00, was 119.16 / 127.50). Q3 10-Q (2026-10-29): Q3 clicks +8% / CPC +4% (was assumed ~+9% / +3%); Q3-Q4 split restated with revenue unchanged; FY2026 clicks 109.82, CPC 103.98. | ROLL FORWARD 2026-11-02 (Kilian card "Roll forward to FY27-FY29"): FY2029 +2.5%: FY2027 +5.6%, FY2028 +3.5% fading (AI Mode monetises fewer paid clicks per query, Q3 call). | CITATION GATE FIX 2026-11-06: FY2027-29 clicks recomputed for the rebased CPC (+4%/yr on 103.98, see cpc) with Search & other revenue unchanged: index 114.28 / 117.15 / 118.92 (was 115.93 / 120.00 / 123.00); value effect 0.

drivers.label: Google Search & other cost-per-click
drivers.source: 10-K FY2025: cost-per-click +7% (2025 vs 2024) https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652044/000165204426000018/goog-20251231.htm; Q2-26 10-Q: CPC +3% (Q2), +4% (H1) https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652044/000165204426000071/goog-20260630.htm; Q3-26 10-Q: CPC +4% (Q3 and 9M), paid clicks +8% / +11% (p. 51 of the IR PDF https://s206.q4cdn.com/479360582/files/doc_financials/2026/q3/GOOG-10-Q-Q3-2026.pdf, src 115; EDGAR https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652044/000165204426000084/goog-20260930.htm); Tinuiti Q3 2026 via Karooya [src 103]; Tinuiti [src 104]; Tinuiti Q2 via SEJ [src 105]; Meta Q3 2026 [src 110]; Q3 call [src 65]
drivers.derivation: REBUILD 2026-11-17 (forecast_lint carry-forward hits: the 'Q2 rate held' / 'Q3 rate held' paths are replaced). CPC = price per paid click, built from auction demand vs click supply and mix: Q4 FY2026 103.5 (+3.5% y/y): Q3 reported +4% (Q3 10-Q monetization metrics, p. 51 [src 115]); Q4 carries 'a slightly larger FX headwind' on Search than Q3 (CFO, Q3 call [src 65]) and FX lands in the dollar price per click: -0.5 pt (estimate). FY2027 +3.6% on each FY2026 quarter: two click pools priced differently. Traditional text ads: Tinuiti Q3 2026 text-ad CPC +6% on clicks +4% (AI Max and Gemini-based bidding lift conversions, e.g. Telstra +52% conversions at -36% cost per order, Q3 call), weight ~60% of clicks; Shopping and AI-surface ads (AI Overviews/AI Mode, PLA): Tinuiti Shopping CPC +3% on clicks +14% (relay [src 103]) with AI Mode monetizing lower (Schindler, Q3 call), +1.5% on ~40%: 0.6 x 5 + 0.4 x 1.5 = +3.6% (text-ad pricing eased to +5% as AI-surface inventory grows; supply-price evidence: Amazon Sponsored Products clicks +13% / CPC -3%, Microsoft clicks -3% / CPC +16%, Tinuiti [src 103]; Meta impressions +10% / price per ad +14% [src 110]). FY2028 +3.1% (AI-surface share ~50%: 0.5 x 4.5 + 0.5 x 1.5 = 3.0, rounded up for Gemini ad-quality gains), FY2029 +2.9% (~55%: 0.45 x 4.5 + 0.55 x 1.5). The weights are estimates (Alphabet does not split clicks by surface). FY2027-28 Search revenue is Kilian's path, so CPC there only splits it (value-neutral); FY2029 CPC moves Search revenue. Alternatives sized in judgment_alternatives (cpc). | PREVIOUS: FY2026 +3.5% = H1 +4% / Q2 +3% (10-Q); FY2027-28 +3%/yr = the Q2 rate held (Tinuiti Q2 CPC +1% is context only per the citation gate; Meta/Amazon ad growth +27%/+26% taking incremental share, agent_2 evidence). | ROLL FORWARD 2026-11-02 (Kilian card "Roll forward to FY27-FY29"): FY2029 +3% = the Q2 FY2026 rate held (live FY2027-28 +3%/yr), flat by quarter as FY2027-28. | CITATION GATE FIX 2026-11-06: FY2027-29 rebased on the reported FY2026 level 103.98 (the carried 106.6 / 109.8 / 113.1 were built on the superseded 103.5, so FY2027 was +2.5%, not the stated +3%). No company, consensus or outside figure gives CPC beyond FY2026 (Q3 call: AI Mode monetizes lower, ads now scaling in AI Overviews/AI Mode, no CPC number [src 65]); best evidence = the latest reported rate, CPC +4% in Q3 and in 9M 2026 (Q3 10-Q, p. 51 [src 115]), applied as +4% y/y on each FY2026 quarter (105/103/104/104): FY2027 108.14, FY2028 112.47, FY2029 116.97 (click-weighted). Search & other revenue is unchanged (Kilian's 2026-10-29 smooth-deceleration path), so paid_clicks takes the other side (clicks = revenue / 56,133 / CPC): value effect 0. Judgment call in judgment_calls_for_kilian.

drivers.label: Google Cloud backlog (remaining performance obligations) at the end of the period
drivers.source: XBRL us-gaap:RevenueRemainingPerformanceObligation (total RPO, "primarily Google Cloud"): 2024-12-31 $93.2B, 2025-12-31 $242.8B (10-K), 2026-03-31 Cloud $462.3B (Q1 10-Q accn 0001652044-26-000048, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652044/000165204426000048/goog-20260331.htm), 2026-06-30 $519.5B of which Cloud $513.9B (Q2 10-Q) https://data.sec.gov/api/xbrl/companyfacts/CIK0001652044.json; Q3 call (sources 64, 68): Google Cloud backlog $561B at 9/30/26, 'just over 55%' recognised over the next 24 months; Q3 call (TPU systems contracted before inventory; Oracle, Crux AI) [src 65]; Anthropic CSP commitment [src 92]; AWS backlog $578B [src 109] | Q1 10-Q IR PDF p. 12 (Cloud $462.3B at 3/31/26) [src 126]
drivers.derivation: REBUILD 2026-11-17 (forecast_lint carry-forward: the $76.99B a quarter 'held flat' is replaced). Real-world basis: Cloud bookings = (1) renewal of what each quarter consumes (revenue drawn from the backlog is re-contracted: book-to-bill 1 on existing use) + (2) multi-year commitments for the new capacity Google brings online, signed ahead of delivery: Kurian, all TPU-system inventory is built 'only ... after we have signed contracts'; the CFO, TPU system agreements show 'first ... in our backlog' then inventory (Q3 call [src 65]); signed-deal disclosures: Anthropic's commitment of at least $111.1B to Google between April 2026 and July 2033 (Reuters on the prospectus, Business Day [src 122]), TPU partnerships with Oracle and Crux AI 'with more in the works' (Q3 call). Forward cover on new capacity = (bookings - revenue) / the quarter's rise in annualized Cloud revenue, measured on the filed quarters: Q2 2026 (76.37 - 24.77) / 18.96 = 2.72 years, Q3 (77.61 - 30.71) / 23.76 = 1.97 years (Q1 / Q2 / Q3 10-Qs: Cloud backlog 462.3 at 3/31/26 [src 126], 513.9 at 6/30/26 [src 2], 560.8 at 9/30/26 [src 76]); mean 2.35 years. Forecast bookings = Cloud revenue + 2.35 x 4 x (q/q rise in Cloud revenue on the capacity path): Q4 FY2026 81.9, FY2027 401, FY2028 514, FY2029 661 $B. Quarter-end backlog = prior + bookings - Cloud revenue: YE2026-29 607.0/811.0/1040.2/1303.5 $B. Cross-check: YE2029 backlog / Q4 FY2029 annualized Cloud revenue = 2.97x vs AWS $578B backlog ('Backlog is $578 billion, growing triple digits year over year', CEO Andy Jassy on Amazon's Q3 2026 call, aboutamazon.com 2026-10-30 [src 109]) / $184B annualized run rate (Amazon Q3 2026 release [src 108]) = 3.14x at Q3 2026 (gate round 3: each figure now cited to the page that shows it) and Google's own 4.6x at 9/30/26. No line item reads the backlog (Cloud revenue is capacity-led since the 11-09 rebuild), so the path has no value effect. | PREVIOUS: Year-end convention (agg end, quarterly build 2026-10-29): base = YE2025 242.8 (10-K), y1 = YE2026, y2 = YE2027, y3 = YE2028 (new, estimate). Q3 update 2026-10-28 (the XBRL script found no Q3 quarter; Q3 from the call): Cloud backlog $561B at 9/30 (call) vs Cloud $513.9B at 6/30 (Q2 10-Q): Q3 bookings 561 - 513.9 + 30.7 = 77.8, book-to-bill 2.53. YE2026 = 561 + Q4 bookings at book-to-bill 2.0 x Q4 Cloud ~34.4 - 34.4 = 595.4 (was 577; 2.0 kept: Anthropic-size deals assumed not to repeat every quarter). YE2027 = 595.4 + 2027 Cloud 195.8 x (1.5 - 1) = 693.3 (was 660; book-to-bill 1.5 kept). YE2028 810.9 = 693.3 + 2028 Cloud 235.2 x (1.5 - 1) (book-to-bill 1.5 kept; feeds no line item). FY2028 Cloud in the set paths = cloud_backlog_y2 (693.3) x cloud_conv_y3 (0.3392) = 235.2B, as the live cloud_backlog_y3 x cloud_conv_y3. | ROLL FORWARD 2026-11-02 (Kilian card "Roll forward to FY27-FY29"): quarter-end = prior + quarter Cloud revenue x (1.5 - 1): book-to-bill 1.5 kept (live YE2027-28 method). | CITATION GATE FIX 2026-11-06: the carried book-to-bill 1.5 (an earlier round's assumption) is replaced. No company or consensus figure gives Cloud bookings after Q3 2026 (Q3 call: TPU partnerships with Crux AI and Oracle 'with more in the works', no amount [src 65]). Best evidence = the reported signings rate: Q2 2026 bookings 513.9 - 462.3 + 24.768 = 76.37 and Q3 560.8 - 513.9 + 30.709 = 77.61 (Q1 / Q2 / Q3 10-Qs [src 126, 2, 76]), mean 76.99 $B a quarter held flat from Q1 FY2027. Quarter-end backlog = prior + 76.99 - quarter Cloud revenue after the dc_mor delay (Cloud FY2028-29 on Kilian's +20% path, card 2026-11-06 02:31Z): YE2027 718.9, YE2028 798.9, YE2029 833.1 (was 702.6 / 820.2 / 957.4); book-to-bill FY2027 1.65, FY2028 1.35, FY2029 1.13. Conversion = revenue / opening backlog, so the backlog path has no value effect; judgment call in judgment_calls_for_kilian. | CLOUD REBUILD 2026-11-09 (Kilian card 2026-11-09 04:18Z option B 'Capacity-led, Cloud share falls'; proposal driver_models/GOOGL/proposal_cloud_path_2026-11-08.md): quarter-end = prior + bookings - Cloud revenue on the new capacity path (Q4 FY2026 bookings 70.67 kept, then $76.99B a quarter as before): YE2026-29 595.8, 707.4, 734.4, 653.0. Revenue no longer reads the backlog (it is the check: Q4 FY2026-Q3 FY2028 Cloud 432.6 $B vs just over 55% of the $567.7B backlog in 24 months ~312 $B, 10-Q, so ~121 $B must come from bookings after 9/30 and usage outside the backlog: bookings ran ~$77B a quarter in Q2-Q3 2026). No value effect. | GATE FIX 2026-11-09: Q4 FY2026 bookings now at the measured $76.99B a quarter too (the 70.67 kept from an earlier round's book-to-bill 2.0 is dropped); capex re-read moves Cloud revenue: YE2026-29 602.2/712.7/735.7/646.0. No value effect.
